name: ClipRect
description: A widget that clips its child using a rectangle. Useful for preventing child widgets from overflowing or for applying custom rectangular animations.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the rectangle clip.

properties.name: clipper
properties.description: A custom clipper that defines the clipping rectangle.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content if it overflows the rectangle boundary.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
